title: Patch-Derived or Register Tokens? Comparing Variable-Length Image Tokenizers
abstract: arXiv:2610.33540v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image tokenizers convert pixels into compact latent sequences for efficient generative modeling. Most approaches arrange latents on a downsampled two-dimensional grid, tying sequence length to image resolution. We compare two variable-length strategies: computationally efficient patch-derived tokens, which inherit explicit spatial organization, and more demanding register tokens, which have no predefined spatial layout. Our reconstruction results reveal that patch-derived tokens perform substantially better under extreme compression, whereas register tokens achieve slightly better reconstruction quality at intermediate budgets. At high token budgets, both approaches achieve similar reconstruction quality. For downstream generative tasks, register tokens outperform patch-derived tokens. translated_title: 补丁衍生标记还是注册标记？比较可变长度图像分词器
translated_abstract: 图像分词器将像素转换为紧凑的潜在序列，以实现高效的生成建模。大多数方法将潜在表示排列在下采样的二维网格上，使序列长度与图像分辨率绑定。我们比较了两种可变长度策略：计算高效且继承显式空间组织的补丁衍生标记，以及要求更高、没有预定义空间布局的注册标记。我们的重建结果显示，补丁衍生标记在极端压缩下表现明显更好，而注册标记在中等预算下实现略好的重建质量。在高标记预算下，两种方法实现相似的重建质量。对于下游生成任务，注册标记优于补丁衍生标记。加入与外部预训练视觉编码器的表示对齐，可显著提升补丁衍生标记的生成性能……
tldr: 该论文系统比较了补丁衍生标记与注册标记两种可变长度图像分词策略，发现补丁衍生标记在极端压缩下表现显著更好，注册标记在中等预算下重建质量略优且在下游生成任务中表现更佳，而加入表示对齐可大幅提升补丁衍生标记的生成性能。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares patch-derived and register token strategies for variable-length image tokenizers, finding that patch-derived tokens perform substantially better under extreme compression, while register tokens achieve slightly better reconstruction at intermediate budgets and outperform in downstream generative tasks, with representation alignment substantially boosting the generative performance of patch-derived tokens.
